title: A stranger who types a mobile at check-in learns whether it belongs to a gym member
what: A number on the gym's list gets the "go to the desk" answer, while a number on no list gets "the gym doesn't have your number". The test pins both answers, so anyone with the app can learn which numbers are the gym's members, a few tries a day per new install.
expected: A typed number gets the same answer whether or not it is on the list, and a test checks the two answers match.
fix_line: Give one desk answer for every typed number and test that it is the same

title: No test checks a sent report is kept 30 days from sending
what: The report test checks only that a request expires 30 days after it was asked. The server restarts the 30 days when the file is sent, but nothing tests that, so a change could delete a report early or keep it too long.
expected: A test sends a file late in the 30 days and checks the new end is 30 days after sending.
fix_line: Add one check on the end date right after a file is sent

title: Declining a check-in number or a plan request is barely tested
what: For a no, the tests check only that nothing was linked or changed. Who declined and when, the 14 days a declined number stays listed, and pressing No twice are never checked, for check-in numbers or for pause and renew requests.
expected: Tests read back who declined and when, press No twice and get the same answer, and check a declined number leaves the list after 14 days.
fix_line: Add the who, when, repeat and 14-day checks to the two tests

title: Taken-back messages and a staff try at sending are not checked against the daily limit
what: The limit test never takes a message back before counting to 10, never checks a refused staff send leaves the day's count alone, and never checks a taken-back message leaves the member's list or that a read message is marked read.
expected: Tests take one back and still hit the limit at 10, try a staff send and count again, and read the member list after a take-back.
fix_line: Add three checks to the message limit test

title: A pass member's check-in is tested with one scan only
what: Pass members are checked in once in the tests. A second scan the same day, another gym's poster, the rate limits and the gym name and first name in the answer are tested only for paying members.
expected: The pass member test scans twice, scans another gym's poster and reads the names in the answer.
fix_line: Add the repeat and other-gym scans to the pass member test

title: Trainer rules for a removed person, another trainer's member and moving a member are untested
what: No test ticks a removed person as trainer, checks a help mark is not shown to the wrong trainer, or moves a member from one trainer to another and checks only the new trainer sees them.
expected: Tests try each of the three and check the refusal or that only one trainer sees the member.
fix_line: Add three cases to the trainer test
